regions.region: page 1 title, author block and abstract
regions.finding: Verified the source-derived title and aggregate Pd/Brønsted-acid kinetic-resolution claim. The abstract gives no additional row-specific experiment beyond later tables/figures.

Prior conjugate-addition/anion-trapping approaches, the envisioned propargylic-alcohol transformation, and the generic current carboxylation are classified separately as literature examples or general schemes; they are not counted as current experiment rows.

Narrative values for Table 1 entries 1–4 were reconciled with the table on page 2 and merged into those four independent optimization records. Main-text references to unseen Supplementary tables were not used to import SI-only facts.

unresolved: Figure 1 conceptual/prior-work structures contain generic substituents and do not define unique current-paper experiments.
The cited Supplementary optimization tables are not associated in the workspace and were not imported.

regions.finding: Figure 1a is molecular context only; b is a conceptual allene approach; c/d are cited prior work; e is an envisioned/question-marked transformation; f is the generic current reaction class. No figure arrow was promoted to an experiment-specific yield.

Four independent optimization rows were retained with shared 1a/[Pd(π-allyl)Cl]2/chiral-ligand/(PhO)2POOH/H2O/toluene/CO conditions, row PPh3 presence, time, three product/recovery outcomes, NMR basis, HPLC e.e., negative e.e. signs, and printed dash markers.
The main text reports a distinct (S)-DTBM-SEGphos optimum at −5 °C/1 atm CO giving (R)-2a in 41% NMR yield and 94% e.e.; only facts restated in the main paper were used.
The prose introduces the Figure 2 scope and is linked to the 27 page-3 row records rather than duplicated.

No SI association was inferred despite explicit citations to Supplementary Tables.

regions.region: page 3 Figure 2 reaction header and 27 product structures
regions.finding: All 27 scope structures 2a–2aa were treated as distinct experiments with shared or footnote-overridden temperature, acid loading and time, plus row yield/e.e./selectivity-factor values. Superscript additives/overrides are structured, not left only in notes.

The narrative introduces five Figure 3a rows. Each row is retained as one ordered two-stage experiment with first product, recovered alcohol, second product and total-both-enantiomer outcomes kept distinct.

regions.finding: Five independent 10/50 mmol successive-resolution runs were retained. First-stage (S)-2 yields/e.e./masses, recovered (S)-1 recovery/e.e./masses, second-stage (R)-2 yields/e.e./masses, and total yields/masses remain separately targeted.

Five independent derivatizations were retained with every caption reagent/loading/solvent/time/temperature. The two-operation methylation/DIBAL sequence is ordered as −5 °C/1.5 h then −78 °C/4 h, and its 77% is an overall yield from (R)-2a to (R)-7.
The first-order 1a observation and separate (R)-1a/(S)-1a kinetic tests were linked to Figure 4 records on page 5. References to unassociated Supplementary Tables were not expanded.

Figure 3b omits scale, workup, purification, masses and yield bases.
Exact kinetic point values remain in unassociated Supplementary Tables.

regions.finding: Two with/without-PPh3 1a profiles and two optically active R/S-1a profiles were retained separately with printed ln([1a])-versus-time slopes and explicit first-order/sluggishness observations.

The with/without-PPh3 monitored reactions reuse the same two parallel profiles rather than creating four plot-specific duplicates. Printed text comparisons for product formation, recovery and e.e. are retained; graph points were not guessed.
Parallel reactions were monitored at 0 °C by 1H NMR and HPLC; PPh3 accelerates formation after 4 h and increases recovered-alcohol e.e., while product e.e. remains similar.

unresolved: Exact point-by-point plot values and complete reagent charges are not printed on pages 1–6 and were not reconstructed from graph pixels.

regions.finding: A distinct no-(R)-DTBM-SEGphos control gives 6% (±)-2a and 94% recovered (±)-1a under the displayed PdCl2/PPh3/acid/H2O/toluene/CO/0 °C/18 h conditions.

regions.region: page 6 Figure 5b complex C preparation and ORTEP
regions.finding: The [Pd(π-cinnamyl)Cl]2/(R)-DTBM-SEGphos/THF/25 °C/2 h preparation of complex C is one partial experiment. The ORTEP is characterization, not a second synthesis.
Four independent pre-catalyst-C controls were retained with row-specific added 2.8 mol% chiral ligand and/or 20 mol% PPh3, NMR yield/e.e. or dash marker, and recovered-1a values.
The explicit 20 mol% P(O)Ph3 variation gives (S)-2a in 34% yield/88% e.e. and 61% recovered (S)-1a; phosphine oxide is kept distinct from PPh3.

The PdCl2/(R)-DTBM-SEGphos/PPh3 mixture in DCM/C6D6 is retained as an analytical experiment with printed phosphorus shifts and non-observation of phosphine oxides, not as a preparative reaction or duplicate complex-C synthesis.
